title: Salt
instructions: Cut the steak in small squares and cook in hot fat till well browned. Add the flour,  garlic sliced, and the chili pulp prepared as below (or use green or red peppers and season with cayenne ). Let simmer about two hours, adding more water if necessary. Season to taste with salt.
